# bloxone_federation_next_available_forward_looking_delegations (Data Source)

Creates and retrieves the next available Forward Looking Delegation objects. Supports creation under a specific Federated Block, a specific Federated Pool, or globally across all available blocks. Forward Looking Delegations are allocated each time the data source is read, including every plan and refresh. Terraform does not track or delete the allocated objects: delete them through the API or the portal before destroying the parent Federated Block, Federated Pool or Federated Realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# NOTE: Forward Looking Delegations are created each time this data source is read (every plan and refresh).
# Terraform does not track or delete them: delete them through the API or the portal before destroying the
# parent Federated Block, Federated Pool or Federated Realm.

# Look up an existing Federated Block
data "bloxone_federation_federated_blocks" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_federation_federated_block_with_pool"
  }
}

# Create the next available Forward Looking Delegations within the Federated Block.
# The protocol (ip4 or ip6) is taken from the block, so it is not set here.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_forward_looking_delegations" "example_by_block" {
  federated_block_id = data.bloxone_federation_federated_blocks.example_by_attribute.results.0.id
  cidr               = 28
  name               = "example_next_available_fld_by_block"
  comment            = "Example next available FLD under block"

  # Number of Forward Looking Delegations to create. Defaults to 1.
  fld_count = 2

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Look up an existing Federated Pool
data "bloxone_federation_federated_pools" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_federation_federated_block_pool"
  }
}

# Create the next available Forward Looking Delegations within the Federated Pool.
# The protocol (ip4 or ip6) must match the protocol of the blocks in the pool.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_forward_looking_delegations" "example_by_pool" {
  federated_pool_id = data.bloxone_federation_federated_pools.example_by_attribute.results.0.id
  cidr              = 28
  protocol          = "ip4"
}

# Create the next available Forward Looking Delegations globally. Neither federated_block_id nor
# federated_pool_id is set, so the tags select the candidate Federated Blocks: at least one Federated Block
# that belongs to a Federated Pool must carry the same tags.
# If several Federated Blocks (in the same or different Federated Pools) carry the same tags, all of them are
# candidates: the blocks are filled one after another, and the delegations of a single request with a count
# greater than 1 can be spread across them. Use a distinctive tag, or set federated_block_id or
# federated_pool_id, to control where the Forward Looking Delegations are created.
# The protocol also filters the candidate Federated Blocks. Set it whenever the blocks matching the tags can have
# different protocols (ip4 and ip6): blocks of the other protocol are skipped, and the request fails if no matching
# block has this protocol.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_forward_looking_delegations" "example_global" {
  cidr     = 28
  protocol = "ip4"

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the Forward Looking Delegations to be created.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The description for the Forward Looking Delegations. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `federated_block_id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Block. Mutually exclusive with `federated_pool_id`. When set, FLDs are created within this specific block.
- `federated_pool_id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Pool. Mutually exclusive with `federated_block_id`. When set, FLDs are created within this specific pool.
- `fld_count` (Number) Number of Forward Looking Delegation objects to generate. Default 1 if not set.
- `name` (String) The name of the Forward Looking Delegations. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `protocol` (String) The type of protocol of delegation (_ip4_ or _ip6_). Not applicable when using `federated_block_id`: the value is ignored in that case, because the protocol is taken from the block. When neither `federated_block_id` nor `federated_pool_id` is set, it also filters the candidate Federated Blocks, so set it whenever the matching blocks can have different protocols; if it does not match the protocol of any matching block, the request fails.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the Forward Looking Delegations in JSON format. When neither `federated_block_id` nor `federated_pool_id` is set, these tags also select the Federated Blocks that are considered for the allocation, so at least one Federated Block that belongs to a Federated Pool must carry the same tags. If several Federated Blocks carry the same tags, all of them are candidates: they are filled one after another and a single request can spread its delegations across them. Use `federated_block_id` or `federated_pool_id` to control where the delegations are created.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) List of created Forward Looking Delegation objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `address` (String) The address of the delegation, an IPv4 address in form "a.b.c.d" or an IPv6 address. Do not include a prefix length ("/n"); use the _cidr_ field instead.
- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the delegation.
- `federated_realms` (List of String) The resource identifier.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) The description for the delegation. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `federated_pool_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the delegation. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the delegation in JSON format.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `network_compliant` (Boolean) The compliance status of the forward looking delegation, as determined by the federation service.
- `protocol` (String) The type of protocol of delegation (_ip4_ or _ip6_).
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags of the forward looking delegation in JSON format including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
